name: Ayase Touka
source:
Hobbies: Seaside strolling
Skills: Playing the piano
Likes: Children, classical music
Dislikes: Insects, summer (hot seasons)

The school's newly appointed music teacher. Confident and pretty mischievous, she can also be emphatetic and is supportive of her students. Due to her caring nature, she has gained popularity quickly among the students. The students often ask love advice from Touka, but she keeps it a secret that she has never had boyfriend nor any kind of experience in love.
